{{Quote|Solo... you wouldn't be tryin' to lean on me any, would you? What you're describing sounds a lot like protection to me."<br />"We don't like guys who try an' lean on the Boss...|Tinketh Fo and one of his bodyguards to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SW85" />}}
'''Tinketh Fo''', sometimes called "'''Boss'''," was an astute [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pinurquian]] who served as the planetary leader of [[Keyorin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="insider" /> In the aftermath of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] climactic defeat at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]&mdash;emissaries from the newly formed [[Alliance of Free Planets]]&mdash;visited Keyorin and asked Fo to attend the upcoming [[First Conference of Free Peoples]], and represent Keyorin's interests. Although Fo was initially skeptical, he was impressed by Solo's panache and promised to consider the idea.<ref name="SW85" /> the Pinurquian ultimately attended the conference in Endor, listening to speeches from Alliance leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].<ref name="SW90">[[Star Wars (1977) 90|''Star Wars'' (1977) 90]]</ref>
